title: •Labria
caption: •Labria (V)
game_text: Once per game, may ▼ Undercover on Labria. During your control phase, may reveal top card of Reserve Deck. Place revealed card on top of Force Pile, Reserve Deck, or Used Pile.
lore: *Information broker.* *Spy*. Devaronian males instinctively have ‘wanderlust.’ Frustrated that he must be reclusive due to shady past. Suffers from prejudice due to devilish appearance.
